      <T> PagedResult<T> findPagedEntries(String primaryKey, Class<T> entryClass, io.jans.orm.search.filter.Filter filter, String[] ldapReturnAttributes, String sortBy, SortOrder sortOrder, int start, int count, int chunkSize)

    • findAggregatedEntries

      default <T> PagedResult<EntryData> findAggregatedEntries(String primaryKey, Class<T> entryClass, io.jans.orm.search.filter.Filter filter, SearchProjection projection, int start, int count)
      Server-side GROUP BY / DISTINCT search. Returned rows are raw projections without DN (they represent groups, not entries). PagedResult.totalEntriesCount is the total number of groups (or distinct rows) matching the filter; start/count page over groups.

    • findDistinctEntries

      default <T> List<T> findDistinctEntries(String primaryKey, Class<T> entryClass, io.jans.orm.search.filter.Filter filter, SearchProjection projection, int start, int count)
      SELECT DISTINCT over projection attributes, mapped to partial entity beans. Only projected properties are populated and the DN property is null — returned beans must not be passed to merge/remove. Projection must be distinct-only (no aggregates).
